messages:
Hannah W: FYI - HydraHealth POC just dropped a big ask: they want a SOC 2 bridge letter (covering last 12 months), ISO Annex A control mapping, a redacted pen-test executive summary (they specifically asked NOT for exploit PoCs), a signed external-scan/pen-test authorization, and confirmation we can do a red-team retest on a dedicated pool. Also asked for encryption-at-rest key rotation policy and an attack-surface diagram. Who owns each piece?

Diego M: Security side: we can provide the SOC2 bridge letter + Annex A mapping + redacted pen-test exec summary (remove PoCs and hostnames). Pen-test authorization is legal-signature + scope from security. Red-team retest is allowed but only on single-tenant dedicated infra and after vendor COI/ATO + approved scope. If they want proof of KMS separation for Private deployments we can produce a keyflow diagram and a BYOK statement.

Claire R: Ops notes: usual pattern = presigned S3 for artifact exchange + timeboxed jumpbox SSH tokens. We never hand out host root creds. If they need a warmed dedicated pool for a retest we bill as a reserved burst. VPN instead of IP allowlist adds ~1 business day set up and an extra ops fee.

Hannah W: They want a night window retest (10h) on 4x A100 and asked about a ballpark. Also asked if we can include a short SLA line in the attestation saying scans will be isolated to the agreed window.

Diego M: Ballpark for a 10h 4x-A100 reserved retest: infra ~$3,000 + ops/scheduling/support ~$400 => ~$3.4k one-time. VPN setup + network validation adds ~ $900 and 1 business day. I'll confirm with capacity team but flagging it's billable.

Ben L: Legal: GC can sign the standard pen-test attestation. We can include the SLA isolation sentence: "Testing will be limited to the mutually agreed scope and window; Redwood Inference will not accept responsibility for issues outside that scope." If HydraHealth sends redlines (especially indemnity changes) expect 3-5 business days review and potential exec escalation.

Claire R: Action items: 1) I'll create presigned upload for vendor docs and put an ops-runbook checklist there. 2) Diego to prepare Annex A mapping + redacted pen-test exec summary. 3) Ben to draft signature-ready pen-test attestation including optional BYOK line. 4) Hannah to ask buyer for vendor COI, vendor ATO, exact host list, and whether VPN required.

InfraBot: Pre-signed upload created: https://uploads.redwood-inference.com/presign/hydra-3167890000 (expires in 48h). Please upload vendor COI, ATO, scan scope & any redline requests to /hydra/scan-request/.

Hannah W: Uploaded the buyer's initial scope doc to the presign link and asked for final IP list and COI. Told them preliminary cost ~ $3.4k for the night retest and that legal can sign the attestation after scope confirmed.

Diego M: Uploaded Annex A draft and redacted pen-test exec summary to the presign location. Note: removed PoCs and shortened exploitation timeline. Marked as redacted_v1.

Ben L: Draft attestation posted to presign folder as `pen-test-attestation-draft.docx`. Included optional BYOK clause. Tag me on any redlines.

Hannah W: Buyer responded asking if we can cover the red-team retest against their Private VPC (BYOK). Told them we can do it but we'll need network validation, a short ops change window, and final quote after capacity & network review. They're okay with the $3.4k ballpark pending final quote.

Claire R: Noted. If they choose Private VPC + VPN we'll add the $900 network validation fee and one extra day to schedule. Scheduling lead time will be ~3 business days from approval.

Ben L: Final legal note: we will not accept broadened indemnity. Any request to alter liability caps must go to execs and will delay sign-off.

Hannah W: Thanks all 44d I'll coordinate with the buyer to get COI, final IP list, and any legal redlines. Will update thread when they send redlines.
